en.headline: 15 own commits plus 23 automated; issue #9 smoke test opened and closed
en.summary: On 2026-10-19 `sogeisetsu` made **15 own commits** across three repositories plus 23 automated commits by `github-actions[bot]`. Ten own commits went to `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu`: a summary-rendering fix so `###` headings no longer swallow the next paragraph, a `check.yml` verify-window assertion fix, an activity pagination fix for HTTP 422, and a new AI all-failure diagnosis with a manual `/oc` re-check. Temporary test edits that broke model ids and the `/oc` login gate were reverted, and the codemap baseline was refreshed twice. `sogeisetsu/opencode-agent-sandbox` saw three commits moving eval artifacts into `evals/`, adding a DeepSeek V4.1 flash demo, and starting a `reading-notes` category. Two commits in `sogeisetsu/opencode-skill-management` revised the spec toward dual-channel distribution and a v5 draft. Issue activity was 5 events on `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu`#9, a temporary `/oc` smoke test opened, commented on, and closed. Three replies arrived: two from `github-actions[bot]` on that issue and one from `yulia-ivashko` on `openchamber/openchamber`#4899, which she closed with #4111. No pull requests, reviews, releases, or discussions were recorded, and no section hit its cap.

zh.headline: 本人提交 15 次、自动提交 23 次，issue #9 冒烟测试开并关
zh.summary: 2026-10-19，`sogeisetsu` 在三个仓库共完成 **15 次本人提交**，另有 23 次由 `github-actions[bot]` 自动提交。其中 10 次本人提交落在 `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu`：修复 summary 渲染，使 `###` 小标题不再吞掉后一段正文；修正 `check.yml` 的 verify 窗口断言；修复活动事件分页对 HTTP 422 的处理；并新增 AI 全失败自动诊断与手动 `/oc` 补查入口。为验收临时改坏 model id 与 `/oc` 登录门的改动已回滚，codemap 基线刷新两次。`sogeisetsu/opencode-agent-sandbox` 有 3 次提交，把测评产物收进 `evals/`、加入 DeepSeek V4.1 flash 演示，并新增 `reading-notes` 类别。`sogeisetsu/opencode-skill-management` 有 2 次提交，把规范改为双通道分发并推进 v5 预改稿。issue 方面共 5 条动态，集中在 `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu`#9 这个临时 `/oc` 冒烟测试上，该 issue 被新开、评论后关闭。共收到 3 条回复：两条来自 `github-actions[bot]`（在该 issue 下），一条来自 `yulia-ivashko`（在 `openchamber/openchamber`#4899 下），她同时关闭了该 issue 与 #4111。当天没有 PR、review、release 或 discussion，也没有任何板块触及采集上限。
